chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one closest to the deceased among the people should pray over the funeral, or he should instruct the one he wishes.

key_terms.أَوْلَى النَّاسِ: The closest of the people (in terms of kinship or right)

ai.seo_question: Who is responsible for leading the funeral prayer according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the primary rule for leading the funeral prayer (Salat al-Janazah), prioritizing the closest relative (awlā) to the deceased, reflecting the Shia emphasis on familial hierarchy in ritual duties. It also grants the right holder the discretion to delegate this honor to another, highlighting the flexibility within the jurisprudential framework regarding communal leadership in mourning rites.
